name: Channel Well Technology Co.,Ltd.
summary: Channel Well Technology Co.,Ltd. researches, develops, produces, sale of power supply and various electronic components in Taiwan, rest of Asia, the United States, Europe, and internationally. It offers PC and IPC power, PoE injector and modular, open frame, adapter, AI intelligent power supply system, charger, and wireless charger. The company provides transformers, wires, heat sinks, and other components, as well as engages in the general trading business. It serves AI industry, industrial, medical, e-sports, consumer, new energy, networking, and security monitoring industries. Channel Well Technology Co.,Ltd. was incorporated in 1983 and is headquartered in Taoyuan City, Taiwan.
